whats-on-netflix.com/news/netflix-games/.excerpt: In another shake-up for Netflix Games, Spry Fox reveals Netflix has officially pulled out of publishing the upcoming cozy life-sim 'Spirit Crossing'.

raygunn_releasedate.headline: Ray Gunn
raygunn_releasedate.summary: Brad Bird’s long‑awaited sci‑fi noir animation will debut on Netflix in December 2026.
highlights: Runtime is 1 hour 59 minutes
Rated PG for violence, language and thematic elements
Will premiere globally on Netflix on December 18 2026

the_rookie_season9_announcement.headline: The Rookie
the_rookie_season9_announcement.summary: Season 9 of the ABC procedural is in production and will add a new rookie to the LAPD division.
highlights: Season 9 has entered production
A new rookie will join the Mid‑Wilshire Division
The season is slated to premiere early next year

galapagos_trailer_unveiled.headline: Galapagos: The Last Eden
galapagos_trailer_unveiled.summary: A new immersive XR experience narrated by Margot Robbie premieres at Venice Film Festival’s Immersive strand.
highlights: Trailer unveiled featuring 3‑D camera tech
Narrated by Margot Robbie, who visited the islands at 18
Focuses on conservation and climate‑change impacts

swat_exiles_trailer.headline: S.W.A.T. Exiles
swat_exiles_trailer.summary: Starz’s new spin‑off follows Hondo as he leads a fresh LA team after a botched raid.
highlights: Trailer reveals a new squad of young recruits
Series premieres on Friday, September 25 on Starz

days_casting_sami_daughter.headline: Days of Our Lives
days_casting_sami_daughter.summary: Sydney Malakeh and Franco LoPresti have been cast in new roles on the Peacock soap.
highlights: Sydney Malakeh will debut as Sydney DiMera on Sept 9
Franco LoPresti joins as Dante, arriving Sept 14

deptq_s2_casting_jamescorden.headline: Dept. Q
deptq_s2_casting_jamescorden.summary: James Corden joins the cast of Dept.
highlights: Corden’s first serious drama role
Season 2 filming runs June‑October adapting the novel Disgrace

mandalorian_cast_replacement.headline: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
mandalorian_cast_replacement.summary: Gavin Hammon takes over as the voice of Din Djarin in the new LEGO animated special on Disney+.
highlights: Gavin Hammon replaces Pedro Pascal as Din Djarin’s voice
The LEGO special premieres on Disney+ today
All other main cast members reprise their roles

practicalmagic2_recast_joeyking.headline: Practical Magic 2
practicalmagic2_recast_joeyking.summary: Evan Rachel Wood says she wasn’t invited back as the film recasts her original role, with Joey King now playing Kylie Owens.
highlights: Joey King cast as Kylie Owens in the sequel
Original cast members, including Wood, were recast
Wood publicly expressed disappointment on Instagram

fillion_captain_kirk.headline: Star Trek: The Animated Series
fillion_captain_kirk.summary: Nathan Fillion was cast as Captain Kirk for a special script reading of the classic episode “Mudd’s Passion.”
highlights: Fillion performed the Captain Kirk role in a live script reading at a WGF event
The reading also featured D’Arcy Carden as Spock and Paul Scheer as Montgomery Scott

post_production_tax_credit.headline: California Post-Production Tax Credit Bill
post_production_tax_credit.summary: California Assembly Bill 2319, a post‑production tax credit, cleared the Senate and now awaits Gov.
highlights: Bill passed its final Senate reading on Aug 30
Gov. Gavin Newsom has 30 days to sign the measure
Initial funding allocated at $10 million, with $100 million sought next year

mauielvis_coprod.headline: Māui & Elvis
mauielvis_coprod.summary: New Zealand’s Whakaata Māori and Canada’s APTN announced an Indigenous co‑production sci‑fi comedy series for kids.
highlights: Production to begin Nov 2026 with a 2027 premiere
Series will feature at least 30% te reo Māori dialogue
Collaboration involves Māori and Métis/Cree creators across NZ and Canada
